custom_field: প্রতি প্রশ্নের মান ১ ও ভুল উত্তরের জন্য ০.২৫ কাটা যাবে।

IBA-Faculty-Prep.question: ১) His gaze held an ________ sadness, like an untold story.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option1: incomprihensible
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option2: incomprehansible
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option3: incomprehensible
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option4: incomprehesible
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option5: None of the above
IBA-Faculty-Prep.exp:
• Complete Sentence: His gaze held an incomprehensible sadness, like an untold story.

• Incomprehensible (adjective)
English Meaning: Impossible to understand or grasp; unclear or confusing.
Bangla Meaning: যা বোঝা অসম্ভব, অস্পষ্ট বা বিভ্রান্তিকর।

Example Sentences:
- The instructions were so complex that they were incomprehensible to most of the students.
- The scientist's explanation of the experiment was incomprehensible to anyone without a background in chemistry.
- The melody danced through the air, incomprehensible and mesmerizing.

Source:
1. Cambridge Dictionary.
2. Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy.

IBA-Faculty-Prep.question: ২) She said that she had finished her chores long before. (change the narration)
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option1: She said, "I has finished my chores long before."
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option2: She said, "I had finished my chores long before."
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option3: She said, "I finished my chores long before."
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option4: She said, "I finish my chores long ago."
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option5: She said, "I finished my chores long ago."
IBA-Faculty-Prep.exp:
• Narration এর নিয়মানুযায়ী,
• Indirect এ before থাকলে direct এ তা পরিবর্তিত হয়ে ago হয়।
- আর long ago থাকলে verb এর past indefinite tense হয়।

• Structure:
- Indirect: Subject + said + that + past perfect (sub + had + past participle) + long before.
- Direct: Subject + said, + past indefinite (sub + past form) + long ago.
 
Indirect: She said that she had finished her chores long before.
Direct: She said, "I finished my chores long ago."

IBA-Faculty-Prep.question: ৩) Which of the following is the best opposite in meaning to "Gainsay"?
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option1: Dispute
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option2: Approve
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option3: Refute
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option4: Resist
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option5: Challenge
IBA-Faculty-Prep.exp:
• The closest opposite in meaning to 'Gainsay' is - Approve.

• Gainsay (verb)
English Meaning: to deny or contradict something; to speak against or oppose.
Bangla Meaning: অস্বীকার করা; বিরোধিতা করা।

অপশন আলোচনা:
- Dispute - বিতর্ক করা; তর্ক করা।
- Approve - অনুমোদন করা; মেনে নেওয়া।
- Refute - খণ্ডন করা; প্রমাণিত অস্বীকার করা।
- Resist - প্রতিরোধ করা।
- Challenge - শ্রেষ্ঠত্ব প্রমাণের জন্য প্রতিদ্বন্দ্বিতা, দ্বন্দ্বযুদ্ধ ইত্যাদিতে আহ্বান; প্রশ্ন করা।

Source:
1. Cambridge Dictionary.
2. Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy.

IBA-Faculty-Prep.question: ৪) Taslima wants to learn piano. (Make it complex)
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option1: Taslima wants so that she will learn piano.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option2: Taslima wants that she will be learn piano.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option3: As Taslima wants, she will learn piano.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option4: Taslima wants so therefore she will learn piano.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option5: Taslima wants that she will learn piano.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.exp:
• To + Verb - Object বা Object সদৃশ হলে Complex Sentence এ that + Clause বসে।
এখানে To + Verb টি guitar- Noun এর অনন্তর্নিহিত Verb এর Object সদৃশ হয়েছে।

- মূল Clause এর Verb (wants) present Tense হওয়ায়, এ Clause টাও present Tense এ হবে।
- তবে to + verb সাধারণত Future Indicate করে, তাই এখানে Future (will) হবে। 
- তবে মনে রাখতে হবে, to + verb  যদি উদ্দেশ্য বুঝানোর জন্য আসে, তখন সাধারণত so that বা in order that যুক্ত Clause বসে।

• Simple Sentence: Taslima wants to learn piano.
• Complex Sentence: Taslima wants that she will learn piano.

IBA-Faculty-Prep.question: ৫) What is the antonym of "Hubris"?
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option1: Arrogance
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option2: Authority
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option3: Humility
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option4: Confidence
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option5: None of the above
IBA-Faculty-Prep.exp:
• The antonym of "Hubris" is - Humility.

• Hubris (noun)
English Meaning: excessive pride, arrogance, or self-confidence, often leading to downfall.
Bangla Meaning: অহংকার; অভিমান; গর্ব।

অপশন আলোচনা:
- Humility - বিনয়; ভদ্রতা; নম্রতা।
- Authority - কর্তৃত্ব; ক্ষমতা; নিয়ন্ত্রণ।
- Confidence - আত্মবিশ্বাস; বিশ্বাস।
- Arrogance - গর্ব; অহংকার; অযথা আত্মবিশ্বাস।

Source:
1. Cambridge Dictionary.
2. Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy.

IBA-Faculty-Prep.question: ৬) My friend said, “Long live solidarity!” (Make it indirect)
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option1: My friend wished that solidarity might live long.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option2: My friend prayed that solidarity may live long.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option3: My friend prayed that solidarity might be lived long.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option4: My friend prayed that solidarity to be lived long.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option5: My friend might wished that solidarity might live long.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.exp:
• Narration এর নিয়মানুযায়ী,
- Optative sentence এর ক্ষেত্রে, Optative Sentence এর Direct form কে Indirect form এ রূপান্তর করার নিয়ম:
- said এর পরিবর্তে wished / prayed বসবে।
- inverted comma উঠে গিয়ে that বসবে।
- reported speech এর subject বসে + may/ might বসে
- reported verb এর মূল verb থেকে শেষ পর্যন্ত অংশ বসে।

• Long live solidarity মূলত May solidarity live long. ছিল।
- তাই এটা ধরে নিয়ে Narration Change করতে হবে।
- নিয়ম অনুযায়ী, may - might হবে এবং Subject এর পরে বসবে।

• সুতরাং, নিয়মানুযায়ী,
- Direct Narration: My friend said, “Long live solidarity!”
- Indirect Narration: My friend wished that solidarity might live long.

More Examples:
- Direct Narration: He said, “Long live our unity!”
- Indirect Narration: He wished that their unity might live long.

IBA-Faculty-Prep.question: ৭) Choose the correct meaning of "Garrulous".
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option1: Short-tempered
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option2: Shy and introverted
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option3: Extremely intelligent
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option4: Quiet and reserved
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option5: Excessively talkative
IBA-Faculty-Prep.exp:
• The required answer is - Excessively talkative.

• Garrulous (adjective)
English Meaning: Excessively talkative, especially about trivial matters.
Bangla Meaning: বাচাল; অতিভাষী।

Example Sentence:
- The garrulous old man kept telling stories about his youth without pause.
- She avoided sitting next to her garrulous colleague during meetings.

Source:
1. Cambridge Dictionary.
2. Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy.

IBA-Faculty-Prep.question: ৮) I was helped to finish the manuscript by Bashar. (Make it active)
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option1: Bashar helps me to finishing the manuscript.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option2: Bashar helped me finished the manuscript.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option3: Bashar helped me finish the manuscript.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option4: Bashar helps me to finish the manuscript.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option5: Bashar helps me finish the manuscript.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.exp:
• Make, need, dare, bare, hear, feel, know, ইত্যাদি causative verb গুলোর পর active voice এ bare infinitive অর্থাৎ to উহ্য থাকে। 
- কিন্তু passive এ পরিবর্তন করবার সময় তাদের পর to বসাতে হয়। 

- তাই প্রশ্নে উল্লিখিত - I was helped to finish the manuscript by Bashar. - বাক্যটিকে active করার সময় - 
- প্রথমে  object টি subject রূপে বসবে + causative verb + subject টি object রূপে বসবে + main verb বসবে।
- to উঠে যাবে।

• এই নিয়মানুযায়ী সঠিক উত্তর হবে -
Passive Voice: I was helped to finish the manuscript by Bashar.
Active Voice: Bashar helped me finish the manuscript.

IBA-Faculty-Prep.question: ৯) Which of the following would be most accurately described as an antonym of "Indolent" in the context of a work environment?
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option1: Proactive
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option2: Inactive
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option3: Detached
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option4: Tired
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option5: Slow-moving
IBA-Faculty-Prep.exp:
• Indolent (adjective)
English Meaning: habitually lazy or avoiding work; avoiding exertion. Bangla Meaning: অলস; কর্মবিমুখ।

অপশন আলোচনা:
- Proactive - সক্রিয়; অগ্রগামী; উদ্যোগী।

- Inactive - নিষ্ক্রিয়; কাজহীন।

- Detached - বিচ্ছিন্ন; অজ্ঞাত; আড্ডাহীন।

- Tired - ক্লান্ত; অবসন্ন; অবস্থা যেখানে শরীর বা মন শক্তিহীন।

- Slow-moving - ধীরগতি; খুব ধীর গতিতে চলা।

Source:
1. Cambridge Dictionary.
2. Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy.

IBA-Faculty-Prep.question: ১০) Work hard or regret it later. (Make it simple)
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option1: By working hard, you will regret it later.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option2: Without not working hard, you will regret it later.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option3: Without working hard, you will not regret it later.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option4: Without working hard, you will regret it later.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option5: Working hard, you will regret it later.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.exp:
- Simple Sentence: Work hard or regret it later.
- Compound Sentence: Without working hard, you will regret it later.

• Or যুক্ত Compound Sentence কে Simple করার নিয়ম:
- প্রথমে Without বসে + প্রথম বাক্যের মূল verb এর সাথে ing যোগ হয় + verb এর পরের অংশ বসে (যদি থাকে) + or এর পরিবর্তে (,) বসে + দ্বিতীয় বাক্য/বাক্যাংশ বসে। 
- এখানে দ্বিতীয় বাক্যে শুধু "regret it later" আছে বিধায় এটি future tense এ হবে। 

Source: Advanced Learner's English Grammar & Composition by Chowdhury & Hossain.

IBA-Faculty-Prep.question: ১১) Which of the following is the closest synonym for "Hedonism"?
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option1: Utilitarianism
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option2: Epicureanism
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option3: Stoicism
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option4: Asceticism
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option5: Altruism
IBA-Faculty-Prep.exp:
• The closest synonym for "Hedonism" is - Epicureanism.

• Hedonism (noun)
English Meaning: The belief that pleasure or happiness is the highest good, and the pursuit of pleasure is the most important goal in life.
Bangla Meaning: ভোগবাদ; সুখই জীবনের একমাত্র লক্ষ্য।

অপশন আলোচনা:
- Utilitarianism - সর্বাধিক উপকারের জন্য কাজ করা; বৃহত্তর সমাজের কল্যাণের জন্য ব্যক্তিগত স্বার্থ ত্যাগ।

- Epicureanism - সুখের জন্য বিলাসিতা ও উপভোগের প্রতি আগ্রহ; জীবনকে উপভোগের দৃষ্টিভঙ্গি।

- Stoicism - অপ্রিয় পরিস্থিতিতে আত্মসংযম এবং অবিচলিত মনোভাব বজায় রাখার দর্শন।

- Asceticism - জীবনযাপনে সাধারণতা, ত্যাগ, এবং ভোগবিলাসের প্রতি বিরাগের দর্শন।

- Altruism - পরার্থে নিজেকে উৎসর্গ করা; অন্যের কল্যাণে আত্মত্যাগ।

Source:
1. Cambridge Dictionary.
2. Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy.

IBA-Faculty-Prep.question: ১২) The teacher said, "Love conquers all."(Make it indirect)
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option1: The teacher said It is the love that conquers all.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option2: The teacher said that love conquered all.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option3: The teacher said that love conquers all.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option4: The teacher said that love had conquered all.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option5: The teacher said that love has conquered all.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.exp:
• Narration এর নিয়মানুযায়ী,
- Reported speech দ্বারা যদি কোনো চিরন্তন সত্য বা অভ্যাসগত কর্ম বা ঐতিহাসিক সত্য বা বৈজ্ঞানিক সত্য প্রকাশ পায়, তবে Indirect Narration এ Tense এর কোনো পরিবর্তন হয় না৷
- Reporting verb এর subject এবং verb অপরিবর্তিত ভাবে বসে।
- Inverted comma উঠে that বসে।
- বাকি অংশ অপরিবর্তিত থাকে।

• অর্থাৎ, নিয়মানুযায়ী,
- Direct Narration: The teacher said, "Love conquers all."
- Indirect Narration: The teacher said that love conquers all.

IBA-Faculty-Prep.question: ১৩) What is the most precise meaning of the word "Harangue"?
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option1: A humorous and lighthearted anecdote
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option2: A subtle and persuasive argument
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option3: A scientific discourse on a complex subject
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option4: A short and polite speech
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option5: A long, passionate, and critical speech
IBA-Faculty-Prep.exp:
• The required answer is - A long, passionate, and critical speech.

• Harangue (noun)
English Meaning: a long, passionate, and critical speech, often delivered forcefully to persuade or reprimand.
Bangla Meaning: জোরালো ও দীর্ঘসময় ধরে দেওয়া সমালোচনামূলক বক্তৃতা।

Example Sentence:
- The politician's harangue against corruption lasted for nearly an hour.
- The coach delivered a fiery harangue to motivate his team before the match.

Source:
1. Cambridge Dictionary.
2. Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy.

IBA-Faculty-Prep.question: ১৪) I saw him leaving the venue. (Make it passive)
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option1: He was being seen to leave the venue by me.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option2: He was seen leaving the venue by me.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option3: He had been seen to be leaving the venue by me.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option4: He had seen to be leaving the venue by me.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option5: He was being seen leaving the venue by me.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.exp:
• Active Voice: I saw him leaving the venue.
• Passive Voice: He was seen leaving the venue by me.

• Object + present participle যুক্ত active voice কে passive voice এ পরিবর্তনের সময়-
• object টি Subject হয় + Tense ও Person অনুযায়ী Auxiliary verb বসে + মূল verb-এর past participle বসে + present participle যুক্ত অংশটি বসে + by বসে + Subjectটির objective form বসে।

অর্থাৎ, 
-  present participle থেকে বাক্যের বাকি অংশ অপরিবর্তিত থাকে।
- এক্ষেত্রে শুধু present participle এর পূর্ববর্তী বাক্যাংশের passive form হয়ে থাকে।
- আর, By+ object যুক্ত অংশ বাক্যের শেষে বসে।

IBA-Faculty-Prep.question: ১৫) Which of these words can best replace "Gratuitous" in the context of an action that is unnecessary or uncalled for?
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option1: Strategic
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option2: Superfluous
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option3: Purposeful
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option4: Altruistic
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option5: Compulsive
IBA-Faculty-Prep.exp:
• Gratuitous (adjective)
English Meaning: unnecessary or uncalled for; excessive in a way that is not needed or justified.
Bangla Meaning: অযৌক্তিক; অপ্রয়োজনীয়; অবাঞ্চিত।

অপশন আলোচনা:
- Strategic - কৌশলগত; পরিকল্পিত।
- Meaning: Pertaining to a plan or strategy, usually in a deliberate or calculated manner. It does not match the idea of unnecessary or excessive action.

- Superfluous - অতিরিক্ত; অপ্রয়োজনীয়।
- Meaning: Something that is more than what is needed; unnecessary or excessive, which perfectly aligns with "gratuitous."

- Purposeful - উদ্দেশ্যমূলক; লক্ষ্যযুক্ত।
- Meaning: Done with a clear purpose or reason, unlike "gratuitous," which implies lack of necessity.

- Altruistic - পরোপকারী; মানবিক।
- Meaning: Selflessly concerned for the well-being of others; not related to unnecessary or uncalled-for actions.

- Compulsive - অনিয়ন্ত্রিত; বাধ্যতামূলক।
- Meaning: Driven by an irresistible urge, often in a way that is excessive, but it doesn't directly convey "unnecessary" or "unwanted" in the same way as "gratuitous."

- Correct Answer: খ) Superfluous

Source:
1. Cambridge Dictionary.
2. Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy.

IBA-Faculty-Prep.question: ১৬) The Daisy is one of the finest flowers. (Comparative)
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option1: The Daisy were finer than all other flowers.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option2: The Daisy is finer than any other flowers.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option3: The Daisy are finer than most other flowers.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option4: The Daisy is finer than most other flowers.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option5: The Daisy is finer than most other flower.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.exp:
• Degree এর ক্ষেত্রে,

• One of the যুক্ত Superlative Degree কে Comparative Degree তে রুপান্তর করার নিয়ম:
Subject + verb + Superlative এর comparative form + than most other + প্রদত্ত sentence এর subject.

Superlative degree: The Daisy is one of the finest flowers.
Comparative degree: The Daisy is finer than most other flower.

IBA-Faculty-Prep.question: ১৭) The ________ of their love was found in the silence between their words.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option1: idiosyncrase
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option2: idiosyncrasy
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option3: idiosyncrasey
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option4: idiosyncracy
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option5: None of the above
IBA-Faculty-Prep.exp:
• Complete Sentence: The idiosyncrasy of their love was found in the silence between their words.

• Idiosyncrasy (noun)
English meaning: a strange or unusual habit, way of behaving, or feature that someone or something has.
Bangla meaning: ব্যক্তির বিশিষ্ট চিন্তারীতি বা আচরণ; স্বভাব বৈশিষ্ট্য 

Example: 
- She often cracks her knuckles when she's speaking - it's one of her little idiosyncrasies.
- One of the idiosyncrasies of this printer is that you can't stop it once it has started.

Source:

IBA-Faculty-Prep.question: ১৮) Don’t forget your classwork. (Change the voice)
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option1: Your classwork won’t be forgotten.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option2: Your classwork won’t be forgot.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option3: Your classwork is not forgotten.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option4: Your classwork should not forgoten.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option5: Let not your classwork be forgotten.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.exp:
• Imperative Sentence কে Active Voice থেকে Passive Voice এ পরিবর্তন করার নিয়ম:

এক্ষেত্রে,
• Do not দিয়ে শুরু যুক্ত Imperative Sentence এর Active Voice কে Passive Voice এ রূপান্তরিত করার নিয়ম:
-  প্রথমে Let not বসে, 
- Objectটি subject রূপে বসে, 
- be বসে, 
- মূল Verb-এর Past Participle বসে।

সে অনুসারে, 
- Active Voice: Don’t forget your classwork.
- Passive Voice: Let not your classwork be forgotten.

IBA-Faculty-Prep.question: ১৯) What is the most precise meaning of the word "Iconoclast"?
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option1: A devout follower of religious icons
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option2: A leader who unites different ideological factions
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option3: A person who seeks to overthrow established traditions and beliefs
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option4: A scholar who specializes in ancient scripts
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option5: A sculptor who carves religious figures
IBA-Faculty-Prep.exp:
• The required answer is - A person who seeks to overthrow established traditions and beliefs.

• Iconoclast (noun)
English Meaning: a person who challenges or seeks to overthrow established traditions, beliefs, or institutions, especially religious or societal norms.
Bangla Meaning: সংস্কারবিরোধী; প্রতিমাভঙ্গকারী।

Example Sentence:
- The iconoclast writer gained fame for criticizing long-held cultural traditions.
- Throughout history, many scientific breakthroughs were driven by iconoclasts who questioned conventional wisdom.

Source:
1. Cambridge Dictionary.
2. Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy.

IBA-Faculty-Prep.question: ২০) The cider is so hot that I cannot drink it. (Make it Simple.)
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option1: The cider is so hot for me to drink it.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option2: The cider is too hot for me to drink.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option3: The cider is too hot to drink it.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option4: The cider is going too hot to drink.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option5: The cider was too hot for me to drink.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.exp:
• So + adjective + that যুক্ত বাক্যের দুইটি clause এ ভিন্ন ভিন্ন subject থাকলে, simple করার সময় নিম্নোক্ত structure প্রযোজ্য হয় -
- প্রথমে Subject বসে + auxiliary verb বসে।
-  এরপর too +adjective + for + object ( that এর পরের Word টির object)বসে।
- এরপরে infinitive বসে এবং তারপরে আর object হবেনা.

• Complex Sentence: The cider is so hot that I cannot drink it.
• Simple Sentence: The cider is too hot for me to drink.
